reviews.comment: This class builds your intuition and reasoning on how/why all the algorithms were made, with lectures such as all the graph algorithms and NP theory being super interesting. Super cool class just attend lecture and the homeworks and exams are so easy. Take this prof if you want to understand algorithms while not having much work.

2 stars because he means well. He is a terrible lecturer, and has recycled the same slides (and homeworks) for years. He turns even simple concepts into over complicated jargon. Coming from someone that loves databases, he makes what is supposed to be cool and easy to follow unbearable and confusing. However, he is nice. Exams are open note.

Can't speak for his graduate classes, CSCE 222 was great. I don't really understand a lot of these comments. He is certainly a bit disorganized, but he knows that, so if you feel your test has been graded unfairly then you can usually get it corrected in office hours. He is also extremely nice, and I had no trouble understanding him.

I had so much trouble understanding what he was saying because of his heavy accent. This class was the hardest one I have ever taken. The homework will not help you in life or in the industry (maybe if you want to do research). He does not explain well and only accepts his solutions to the given problems. I would never ever take this class again.

Covers the concepts necessary for cracking coding interviews. The way he taught graphs definitely helped me get through the coding interviews. But more often than not, you will not be able to understand a bit of what he teaches in class. However, if you re-watch the video recording, you're good to go!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Chen's lectures were very hard to follow and his grading criteria were also vague. The class is mostly a repeat of information from 221, so you can get by without understanding his lectures. The pop quizzes were awful(usually over the content we just learned from his ill-taught lecture). However, the tests are more straightforward.

Chen's explanation are unclear and he doesn't do a good job of giving examples to help students understand the concepts better. He talks through concepts but he doesn't write them down. This would lead to him making contradictory statememts which made it harder to understand concepts. There are pop quizzes once a week. Not a good Professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Chen is not a good professor, but from what I understand, just about every 411 prof sucks, so Chen is probably a solid choice. His tests are easy, but he grades like a lunatic. He talks down to students and his lectures are meh at best, but if you don't do questions his way, you'll lose credit. Take chen - use online resources and you'll survive.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures can be hard to understand and there are pop quizzes, but theres plenty of outside resources for this class. I will say the homeworks were fair but challenging and the tests were open note. Grading curve was a 75+ for a B and 65+ for a C. Not bad for 411.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst profs I've had. Grading in this class is so inconsistent it's insane. He also expects you to do your algorithms completely his way (which isn't the most efficient) or it's wrong. I've received test feedback that says "you can do better" or "detailed algorithm not acceptable" etc from him. Avoid avoid avoid.

It is fine to be reasonable and strict but he enjoys being unreasonable and strict. He just reads the slides and has zero passion for teaching. After every question you ask, first he humiliates you with a smirk and then give you a vague answer. Exams were unorganized and the project requirements changed several time. Just avoid him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I did not get A,but he is a excellent prof. Only 33 percent students can get A in his class BTW.
This is a very hard class. Get ready to put in a lot of effort.
